gen-amatic-sc-gf-cossette-texte: Rustic, quirky scrawl from Amatic SC, terminals wandering far from every stem. Cossette Texte keeps long paragraphs open and legible, its sans lowercase wide-eyed, with a prominent x-height throughout.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One brings a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, literary and dignified beneath Amatic SC. And the pipe-like heading keeps things loose while the body settles into steady, dignified reading.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-funnel-sans: Amatic SC draws every stroke like toothpaste squeezed in one line. Funnel Sans, with tidy ascenders and a pried-open e, gives that scrawl something sturdy to lean on.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-gidole: Gidole keeps its sans-serif terminals apart, like open scissor blades. Beneath the rustic scrawl of Amatic SC, its neon-tube strokes and high midline make paragraphs feel orderly and quiet.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-glegoo: Amatic SC scrawls in one unvarying line, rustic and quirky. Glegoo brings big counters and unclosed curves, and its tall lowercase reads in a refined, editorial hush down the page.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-golos-text: Amatic SC lays down one squeezed-toothpaste line, rustic and a bit quirky. Golos Text, with an x-height that fills the line and a widely parted s, gives that wobble a friendly partner.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hanuman: Wiry, quirky lettering from Amatic SC leads, each stroke looking cut from wire. And Hanuman, high-waisted with wide-set terminals on s, supplies the traditional refinement that anchors the pair.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-hind-mysuru: Scrappy, quirky handwriting from Amatic SC, stroked out in one wobbly line. Hind Mysuru, a sans with no calligraphic thinning, can be sized up a notch, since its tops press near the ascender height.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-huninn: Amatic SC draws quirky letters like toothpaste squeezed out in one steady line. Huninn, sans-serif with close-to-cap lowercase and sturdy crossbars, reads smoothly across a full page of text.
gen-amatic-sc-gf-julius-sans-one: Amatic SC lays down a line like toothpaste squeezed out steadily, with terminals stopping far from the stem. Julius Sans One counters with generous letter gaps and open curves.
